description:
enforce_dns_limit() converts entire @@dns_cache to array and sorts by expiry on every insert when full.

With 10,000 entries this is O(n log n) under a mutex lock, blocking all DNS operations.

Fix: Use a min-heap or ordered Deque to track expiry order efficiently, or use random eviction instead of LRU for DNS cache.
title: DNS cache eviction does O(n log n) sort on every insert under mutex
